3.description: [Web] We have included an unpacked variant of the launcher for users who encounter problems with the installer. Please note that this alternative version does not include features such as automatic updates and the installation of missing Visual C++ Redistributable packages. The primary goal of providing this unpacked version is to help users quickly get the launcher up and running if they face difficulties with the standard installer.
[Launcher] Removed unnecessary additional modals popping up when pressing Repair button.
[Launcher] The downloader will now kill the client, if it is running during download and is locking files from being updated.
[Launcher] Fixed an issue with download status reactivity. This notably fixes the "Seeding" visual bug (that disappears if you change tab).
